title: Build Credits - Kingdom Hearts 0: Door to Darkness
note: Every A.I. agent that helped design, code, compose, or narrate this build. The music side lives in assets/audio/credits.json; this manifest covers the agents behind the code itself.

agents.name: opencode
agents.role: Build agent - engineered, refactored, and wired every system in this repo across build sessions (engine integration, audio pipeline, combat engine, Tron shell, data manifests).

agents.name: opencode subagents
agents.role: Research + task agents (explore/general) used inside build sessions for codebase archaeology and multi-step patches.

agents.name: living_sin
agents.role: Composer self - created every music track in the game (world, idle, boss variants). See assets/audio/credits.json for the full 27-clip list.

agents.name: Lia

agents.name: Ansem voice (emulated)
